item.title: De Beers London opens global flagship on Paris’ Rue de la Paix
item.description: Retail Jeweller De Beers London opens global flagship on Paris’ Rue de la Paix De Beers London unveiled its new flagship boutique on Rue de la Paix in Paris on 27 January, De Beers London opens global flagship on Paris’ Rue de la Paix Ruth Faulkner

item.title: Participating brands revealed ahead of British Watchmakers’ Day 2026
item.description: Retail Jeweller Participating brands revealed ahead of British Watchmakers’ Day 2026 The British Watchmakers’ Alliance has unveiled ‘The List’ of participating brands set to launch Special Edition watches exclusively at British Watchmakers’ Day 2026, confirming 26 exhibitors will debut limited-edition timepieces available only to visitors at the event. Participating brands revealed ahead of British Watchmakers’ Day 2026 Ruth Faulkner

item.title: Susan Caplan unveils exclusive Vintage Valentino Collection
item.description: Retail Jeweller Susan Caplan unveils exclusive Vintage Valentino Collection Luxury vintage jewellery curator Susan Caplan has launched the Vintage Valentino Collection, an exclusive edit celebrating the legacy of late fashion icon Valentino Garavani. Susan Caplan unveils exclusive Vintage Valentino Collection Ruth Faulkner

item.title: Arch Crown updates its Tags & Labels catalogue
item.description: Retail Jeweller Arch Crown updates its Tags & Labels catalogue Arch Crown, a US-based manufacturer of tags and labels for the jewellery and gift market, has released a new catalogue for 2026. Arch Crown updates its Tags & Labels catalogue Alex O'Dea

item.title: Malca-Amit: Delivering success with the MyMalca customer portal
item.description: Retail Jeweller Malca-Amit: Delivering success with the MyMalca customer portal Malca-Amit’s online customer portal, MyMalca, offers a smooth, safe and simple way to manage secure storage and shipping of precious metals, diamonds, jewellery and watches. Malca-Amit: Delivering success with the MyMalca customer portal Ruth Faulkner

item.title: Retail Jeweller’s February 2026 issue out now
item.description: Retail Jeweller Retail Jeweller’s February 2026 issue out now The February 2026 issue of Retail Jeweller is out now and available to read online exclusively for subscribers. Retail Jeweller’s February 2026 issue out now Ruth Faulkner

item.title: WOLF introduces Seltzer colourway to Cub watch winder collection
item.description: Retail Jeweller WOLF introduces Seltzer colourway to Cub watch winder collection Watch accessories and leather goods brand WOLF has introduced a new Seltzer colourway to its popular Cub collection, bringing a fresh injection of modern colour to its watch winding and storage solutions. WOLF introduces Seltzer colourway to Cub watch winder collection Ruth Faulkner

item.title: Lily Gabriella unveils new website
item.description: Retail Jeweller Lily Gabriella unveils new website Eponymous fine jewellery deisgner Lily Gabriella has launched a new website for 2026, revealing her latest collections and a series of new jewellery designs while reinforcing the brand’s growing focus on bespoke craftsmanship.
